mapper.insert: INSERT INTO project (code, name, path, tech_stack, verify_method, default_decision_level, enabled, deleted, summary_status, summary, summary_error, summary_generated_at, created_at, updated_at) VALUES (#{code}, #{name}, #{path}, #{techStack}, #{verifyMethod}, #{defaultDecisionLevel}, 1, 0, #{summaryStatus}, #{summary}, #{summaryError}, #{summaryGeneratedAt}, #{createdAt}, #{updatedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT id, code, name, path, tech_stack, verify_method, default_decision_level, summary_status, summary, summary_error, summary_generated_at, created_at, updated_at FROM project WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0

SELECT id, code, name, path, tech_stack, verify_method, default_decision_level, summary_status, summary, summary_error, summary_generated_at, created_at, updated_at FROM project WHERE summary_status = #{summaryStatus} AND deleted = 0 ORDER BY id
mapper.update: UPDATE project SET summary_status = #{summaryStatus}, summary = #{summary}, summary_error = #{summaryError}, summary_generated_at = #{summaryGeneratedAt}, updated_at = #{updatedAt} WHERE id = #{id} AND deleted = 0
